# @arki/db

> Drizzle ORM helpers for ARKI: Postgres and PGlite runtimes, branded ids, feature-owned schema, repositories for Dot features, and serializable transactional procedures for oRPC. It is not a query builder and not a migration tool.

Only SQLSTATE `40001` and `40P01` are retried. Effects inside a transaction run once per attempt.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/db`: Open a node-postgres pool and wrap it in Drizzle: `initDb`. `DB_COMPOSITION_ERROR_CODES`, `DbCompositionError`, `composeSchema`, `createDb`, `createUnitOfWork`, `getDbConnectionOptions`, `getDbConnectionParams`, `initDb`, `initDbWithOptions`; types `ComposedSchema`, `TransactionalDb`, `UnitOfWork`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/db/env`: Validated database environment variables (`DB_URL`, pool sizes and timeouts). `env`.
- `@arki/db/init`: Open a node-postgres pool and wrap it in Drizzle: `initDb`. `DB_COMPOSITION_ERROR_CODES`, `DbCompositionError`, `composeSchema`, `createDb`, `createUnitOfWork`, `getDbConnectionOptions`, `getDbConnectionParams`, `initDb`, `initDbWithOptions`; types `ComposedSchema`, `TransactionalDb`, `UnitOfWork`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/db/factory`: Build a Drizzle database from the environment: `createDb` and the connection-option helpers. `createDb`, `getDbConnectionOptions`, `getDbConnectionParams`.
- `@arki/db/builder`: A typed builder for event-sourced projections (read models). `initDb`; types `DbBuilder`, `InitialBuilder`, `ProjectionBuilder`, `ProjectionBuilderRoot`, `ProjectionBuilderWithEvents`, `ProjectionBuilderWithName`, `ProjectionDefinition`, `ProjectionHandler`, `ProjectionHandlerContext`, `ProjectionMiddleware`, `ProjectionMiddlewareContext`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/db/client`: types-only client surface.
- `@arki/db/runtime-local`: An embedded PGlite database with an owner lock on its data directory. `DB_RUNTIME_LOCAL_ERROR_CODES`, `DbRuntimeLocalError`, `initDbRuntimeLocal`; types `DbRuntimeLocalErrorCode`, `PgliteInitOptions`.
- `@arki/db/id`: Prefixed cuid2 ids and the column helpers that store them. `AggregatedField`, `CONSTANTS`, `Column`, `ColumnAliasProxyHandler`, `ColumnBuilder`, `ColumnTableAliasProxyHandler`, `ConsoleLogWriter`, `Count`, `DefaultLogger`, `DrizzleError`, `DrizzleQueryError`, `FakePrimitiveParam`; and 328 more.
- `@arki/db/id-factory`: Prefixed id factories (`createIdFactory`) and `idColumns` for ids declared with `defineId`. `AggregatedField`, `CONSTANTS`, `Column`, `ColumnAliasProxyHandler`, `ColumnBuilder`, `ColumnTableAliasProxyHandler`, `ConsoleLogWriter`, `Count`, `DefaultLogger`, `DrizzleError`, `DrizzleQueryError`, `FakePrimitiveParam`; and 328 more.
- `@arki/db/orm`: Re-exports of `drizzle-orm` and its zod helpers, plus `mergeRelations`. `AggregatedField`, `CONSTANTS`, `Column`, `ColumnAliasProxyHandler`, `ColumnBuilder`, `ColumnTableAliasProxyHandler`, `ConsoleLogWriter`, `Count`, `DefaultLogger`, `DrizzleError`, `DrizzleQueryError`, `FakePrimitiveParam`; and 324 more.
- `@arki/db/pg`: Re-export of `drizzle-orm/pg-core`, so a table file imports from one place. `Check`, `CheckBuilder`, `DefaultViewBuilderCore`, `ExtraConfigColumn`, `ForeignKey`, `ForeignKeyBuilder`, `Index`, `IndexBuilder`, `IndexBuilderOn`, `IndexedColumn`, `ManualMaterializedViewBuilder`, `ManualViewBuilder`; and 382 more.
- `@arki/db/temporal`: Postgres columns that read and write `@arki/date` values instead of `Date`. `instant`, `instantFromDriver`, `instantToDriver`, `plainDate`, `plainDateFromDriver`, `plainDateToDriver`; types `InstantColumnConfig`.
- `@arki/db/bun`: The Bun SQL driver entry, used through the `bun` export condition. `BunSQLDatabase`, `createDb`, `getDbConnectionOptions`, `getDbConnectionParams`, `initDb`.
- `@arki/db/dot`: DOT adapter for @arki/db. `DB_PLUGIN_ERROR_CODES`, `db`, `dbMigrations`, `reader`, `repos`, `transactions`, `txRepos`; types `DatabaseOf`, `DbDotOptions`, `DbServices`, `OpenTransaction`, `PgDbDotOptions`; and 7 more.
- `@arki/db/migrate`: Apply Drizzle migrations to a handle opened by @arki/db, whichever driver produced it. `migrateDb`, `pendingMigrations`, `readMigrations`; types `MigratableDb`, `MigrateDbOptions`, `MigrationMeta`.
- `@arki/db/pagination`: Keyset pagination, the server half. `keysetQuery`; types `KeysetColumns`, `KeysetQuery`.
- `@arki/db/transaction`: run work in one SERIALIZABLE transaction, and run it again when PostgreSQL says the transaction lost a race. `DB_TRANSACTION_ERROR_CODES`, `DbTransactionError`, `isDbTransactionError`, `parseTransactionSettings`, `retryableSqlState`, `runTransaction`; types `DbTransactionErrorCode`, `ResolvedTransactionSettings`, `RetryableSqlState`, `TransactionOptions`, `TransactionSettings`, `TransactionalDb`.
- `@arki/db/errors`: Questions about a Postgres error, answered the same way for every driver (node-postgres, PGlite, Bun SQL) and through Drizzle's `DrizzleQueryError`. `isUniqueViolation`.
- `@arki/db/orpc`: one oRPC middleware that makes a contract-first procedure a SERIALIZABLE Postgres transaction. `transactionalProcedure`, `transactionalProcedureConfig`; types `TransactionContext`, `TransactionRepositorySource`, `TransactionScopeOf`, `TransactionalMiddleware`, `TransactionalProcedureOptions`.
- `@arki/db/eslint`: the `no-effects-in-transaction` rule. `default`, `noEffectsInTransaction`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- `transact` is the last `.use()` of the procedure. Anything after it reruns on every retry (`ARKI_DB_TX_E004`).
- Pass `transactionalProcedureConfig` to `implement`, or output is validated after the commit.
- No `fetch`, queue writes or `.effect()` inside transactional code. They run once per attempt and do not roll back.
- A lost connection around `COMMIT` is never retried. Recover with an idempotency key and a journal receipt.
- PGlite never conflicts (one connection). Prove retry behaviour on real PostgreSQL.
- In a Dot feature, rename the pool-bound repos source to `repositories`. The bound set is `repos`.
